chapter_level: One poem, one profile: `urmikavya_geet` applies to every topic in this chapter — this is not a mixed chapter, and no second genre profile is in play. The title-and-poet topic M1.S1.T1 is a CONCEPT topic, so the profile's કડી-shaped gates are applied to it against what the masthead actually prints, not against a stanza it does not have.

The echo-words are the chapter's biggest invention risk. `અલ્લક`, `દલ્લક`, `છમ્મક છમ્મક`, `ઢમ્મક ઢમ્મક`, `ચલ્લક ચલ્લક`, `છલ્લક છલ્લક`, `મલ્લક મલ્લક` (the doubled one) and `પલ્લક પલ્લક` carry no printed meaning anywhere in the chapter; the શબ્દાર્થ box glosses only `ઝલ્લક ઝલ્લક — ઝળકઝળક` and `અલ્લપ-ઝલ્લપ — અલગ દૂરથી આછેરું સંભળાય તે રીતે`. No topic may give any of the ungloseed ones a dictionary meaning, an etymology or a 'correct' spelling. Say what the sound does; do not say what it means.

Std-7 label ceiling, chapter-wide. `figures_of_speech` stays `[]` on every topic, and no અલંકાર name (ઉપમા, રૂપક, વર્ણાનુપ્રાસ, સજીવારોપણ, ઉત્પ્રેક્ષા) and no છંદ name appears in any authored field. The profile's 'skipping the craft' gate is therefore met by an `explanation` sentence in every poem topic, never by a filled `figures_of_speech`. `પ્રાસ` and `લય` are usable words because the chapter's own printed પ્રવેશપેટી uses them: 'એમાં શબ્દો, પ્રાસ, લયનું અદ્ભુત સંયોજન છે.'

Chapter-wide L2 hazard — one person, several names. કૃષ્ણ is called `કાન`, `કાના` and `ગોપીજનવલ્લભ` on these pages; રાધા is called `રાધા`, `રાધિકા` and `રાધાગોરી`. An L2 reader counts them as separate characters and loses the thread across કડીઓ. Every topic that first uses a new name for either must say, in that same sentence, that it is the same person. The book's own printed task 'કૃષ્ણનાં જુદાં જુદાં નામોના અર્થ લખો.' is built on exactly this, so the teaching should prepare it.

Chapter-wide તળપદો register. The book's own printed exercise sends the child to a parent for `ભેળો`, `જડ્યાં`, `આલને`, `રુએ`, `ચરિતર` and `મલક`, and the શબ્દાર્થ box glosses `જમના`, `મલ્લક`, `આલને`, `ચરિતર`, `ચગ્યો છે`, `અધીરું` and others. No authored field anywhere in the chapter may call any of these ખોટું, અશુદ્ધ or a છાપભૂલ, or replace one with its માનક form inside a quoted line. Gloss beside the printed word, at the point of use.

No numerals in display text, and this chapter invites them. The source markers are `[[ટેક]]`, `[[કડી 1]]` … `[[કડી 5]]`, `[[ટેક (પુનરાવર્તન)]]`, and the two ટેક occurrences tempt a numbered reference. The devotional engine is taught as the song it is. The chapter's own tasks are 'આ કાવ્યનું અભિનય સાથે ગાન કરો.' and 'રાધા-કૃષ્ણ વિશેનાં પ્રચલિત લોકગીતો કે રાસ - ગરબા મેળવીને વર્ગમાં રજૂ કરો.', and the પ્રવેશપેટી calls it 'રાધા-કૃષ્ણનું ઊર્મિગીત'. No authored field turns the રાસલીલા into ધર્મ-શિક્ષણ, a comparative-religion note, or a બોધ about ભક્તિ; the living singing tradition — રાસ, ગરબા, શરદ પૂનમની રાત — is the frame. A modern poet writing રાધા-કૃષ્ણ is still a ગીત, not a ભજન. The author slot prints `- બાલમુકુન્દ દવે` and there is no છાપ inside the verse. No authored field may call this a ભજન, a પ્રાર્થના or a મધ્યકાલીન પદ, address it to ઈશ્વર, or hunt it for the બોધ a ભજન would carry.
